title: Orca Multi-Agent Task Orchestration
problem: Single-thread context exhaustion, interactive terminal halts during background subagent execution, and manual worktree/PTY management.
outcome: Native, zero-disruption task orchestration powered by the Orca runtime daemon with deterministic DAG dispatch, unattended agent CLI flag profiles, isolated child worktree workers, structured inter-agent messaging, checkpoint decision gates, and full JSON sidecar traceability.

in_scope: Orca runtime adapter contract in spec-family.yaml
Canonical agent CLI flag profiles across major tools (Claude, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, OpenCode)
Orca orchestration and Agent CLI reference documentation
Skill upgrades for spec-execute, spec-audit, spec-tasks, and spec-finish
Comprehensive JSON sidecar ecosystem across all spec phases (00-05)
Graceful fallback to local sequential execution
non_goals: Altering core Markdown EARS criteria syntax
Making Orca a mandatory dependency for all environments
Reinventing a custom PTY background daemon

approaches.name: Native Orca Integration with Agent CLI Profiles, Sidecar Ecosystem, & Python Bridge
approaches.benefits: Zero-disruption unattended execution, native DAG coordination, worktree isolation, full JSON sidecar validation, durable recovery.
approaches.costs_risks: Requires maintaining cross-agent CLI flag profiles.

approaches.name: Prose-Only Skill Updates
approaches.costs_risks: High disruption risk and manual command typos.

approaches.name: Custom Background Process Manager
approaches.costs_risks: Massive maintenance burden reinventing PTYs and worktrees.

chosen_direction.approach: Native Orca Integration with Agent CLI Profiles, Sidecar Ecosystem, & Python Bridge
chosen_direction.architecture: Coordinator (spec-execute) -> spec-orca.py -> Orca Daemon -> Isolated Child Worktree Workers (Unattended CLI Flags) -> Structured worker_done / decision gates -> 05_execution.json sync
